items.Sentence: The raw wastewater flows through four underground septic tanks arranged in series that provide solids removal and primary biological treatment to reduce nitrogen concentrations.
There are two submersible pumps in the last septic tank that are located within a screen filter.
There are two sets of two submersible pumps located within a screened filter. Each set of submersible pumps then pump the wastewater to a set of four textile filter pods for treatment.
Screened wastewater from the last septic tank enters the recirculation tank via a force main pipeline.

Screened and blended wastewater from the recirculation tank enters the textile filter pods via a force main pipeline. The screened wastewater is pumped into six textile filter pods that are operated in parallel that provide equivalent to secondary treatment. Wastewater is recirculated through the textile filters for further removal of suspended solids and total nitrogen. There are two ventilation fans that aerate the textile filter pods;
Effluent from the textile filter pods enter the dosing tank via a gravity pipeline.
Each of the final filter assemblies contains a BioDisc filter, a bag filter, splitter valves, backwash assembly, and effluent flow meter.

Sludge is removed from the septic tanks annually and it is hauled to the Seeley County Water District (SCWD) dump site.
